items.title: Stuart Bergen Interview, 1970-07-18
items.q: Well Cab Calloway used to jump on.

ctx.x: And what about Solistan's trumpet player?

You were talking about the little guy. Who was that? I don't know who he was. I really don't know. But I know when he shook it and blew. That was over in Pensacola, Florida when they passed through for one night. And boy the little guy leading their band. If the band would make a scream at the end of the court he'd jump up in the air and come down. I mean he could put a band across himself even without a band behind. He was terrific. That's the way they led bands in those days. Well Cab Calloway used to jump on.
Would he be there with a baton or something?
